findings.title: MCP catalogue and resource-source reads followed symlinks outside trusted roots

findings.title: MCP tool arguments lacked field and manifest size bounds
reproduction: Call search_resources with a 201-character query, compose_product with a brief longer than 10,000 characters, or a manifest larger than 1 MiB; these inputs were previously accepted by unbounded tool schemas.
The MCP stdio client regression now verifies oversized values return tool errors; the MCP SDK SSE transport also applies its 4 MiB request-body limit.

findings.remediation: Added explicit bounds to search and brief fields, capped project-manifest tool inputs at 1 MiB, capped source output and local catalogue input, and verified limits through an actual MCP stdio client.

findings.title: CLI accepted unbounded or malformed registry responses and destinations
reproduction: Configure a registry endpoint returning more than 1 MiB and run tess add <slug>; before the fix, the full response was parsed without a byte cap.
Return a JSON object with a valid-looking name/type but an empty or malformed files array; before the fix, the CLI trusted it as RegistryItem.
A remote catalogue response also used response.json() without a decoded-size cap.
The CLI previously relied on generic fetch for configured registry destinations; no DNS pinning or private-network target policy was applied.
findings.passing_test_after_fix: packages/cli/src/__tests__/cli.test.ts verifies oversized registry response rejection and malformed registry record rejection before writes; the normal local button registry installation still passes.
findings.remediation: Added streaming byte-bounded JSON response reading, a 32 MiB catalogue cap, a bounded RegistryItem shape with file and dependency limits, a five-second timeout, HTTPS-only public registry access, DNS address pinning, private/local target rejection by default, and redirect rejection. TESS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_REGISTRY=1 is documented for trusted private registries; HTTP remains limited to local/private resolved targets. Broader destination and DNS edge-case review remains open.

findings.title: Public collection and creator-link responses had unbounded size
reproduction: Seed a public collection with 501 resource rows and request GET /api/collections/:id; before the fix it returned the full list with HTTP 200.
Seed 21 creator links and request GET /api/creator-links/:userId; before the fix no response ceiling existed.

findings.remediation: Added per-owner storage ceilings and bounded D1 reads. Collection and creator-link endpoints fetch at most one record beyond the supported maximum, then return a clear 503 for legacy overflow instead of returning an unbounded response or silently truncating it.

findings.title: Local MCP SSE sessions had no concurrency ceiling

findings.remediation: The loopback compatibility server rejects new SSE sessions with HTTP 503 and Retry-After after eight live sessions. Actual MCP client regressions verify the ceiling and the SDK request body size limit.

findings.title: Cloud project and revision lists could exceed a safe aggregate response size

findings.passing_test_after_fix: apps/api/src/__tests__/cloud-sync-d1.test.ts > bounds aggregate project and revision response sizes

findings.title: Authenticated public remixes bypassed the cloud project ceiling
